Class MathArrowExtension

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.render.flexmark.MathArrowExtension
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.vladsch.flexmark.html.HtmlRenderer.HtmlRendererExtension, com.vladsch.flexmark.parser.Parser.ParserExtension, com.vladsch.flexmark.util.misc.Extension
public class MathArrowExtension extends Object implements com.vladsch.flexmark.parser.Parser.ParserExtension, com.vladsch.flexmark.html.HtmlRenderer.HtmlRendererExtension
Flexmark extension that enables zero-JavaScript rendering of LaTeX math arrows and symbols in Swing.

This extension registers MathArrowPostProcessor to parse LaTeX commands (such as $\to$, $\rightarrow$, $\Rightarrow$, and $\leftrightarrow$) into MathArrowNodes, and MathArrowNodeRenderer to render them as standard Unicode characters in Swing HTML.
